notes: spec 2026-10-07-enemy-ai-and-battle §3.3: first draft. score = value x greed - distance_days x dist_cost - defence x caution - overlap, in gold; town_bonus is added to a town's value; engage_odds_permille = the odds at which the host takes a fight; retreat_morale = the morale below which it retreats. The main host leans to rich towns. siege_<tactic>_permille (player siege spec §4, step 7): the share of the day's men pool the host's siege puts to each of the five tactics (blockade, mine, bombard, ladders, engines), whole men by largest remainder; each row sums to 1000. First draft: the main host blockades with most and digs, builds and readies ladders with the rest; the raider and reserve only blockade
the raiding party leans to undefended manors: greedier, warier, cheap to move, fights only on good odds
the rear host has no target of its own and follows the main host; these rows apply once it is let loose
